_comment: Press/review candidates for Doug Rosenberg, in the shared schema (see SCHEMA.md). Nothing here is a review of the CD Better Than TV unless about==this-cd AND kind==review; as of 2026-10-05 no such review has been found. pullQuotes are short attributed quotes only; full copies live in the shared press-archive folder outside the repo.

entries.title: TRG Music Listings (weekly club calendar), 31 weekly pages naming Doug
entries.notes: Gig calendar entries, NOT reviews. Page URLs are https://chicagoreader.com/news/trg-music-listings-N/ for N in 2, 3, 25, 41-50, 52-59, 63-68, 70, 72-74, 85, 88, 89 (page 51 had no match). Spot-checked: 2003-05-01 lists 'Doug Rosenberg Trio' Fri/Sat at Montage (Naperville), 'Keyon Harrold/Doug Rosenberg Quintet' at Chase Cafe 5/8 and Velvet Lounge 5/7; 2004-06-10 lists 'Goran Ivanovic & Doug Rosenberg' at Chase Cafe 6/11. Useful as dated evidence of regular Chicago gigging 2003-2004; only the other 29 pages are unread beyond the name match.
entries.provenance: Found via the Reader's own site search (36 results) and fetched 2026-10-05.

entries.title: Goran Ivanovic [Group] Live at HotHouse, 2006-12-15
entries.outlet: Internet Archive (Live Music Archive), uploaded by 'thirdofthree' on 2006-12-28
entries.notes: Fan-taped audience recording, NOT a review. Lineup: Goran Ivanovic (guitar), Doug Rosenberg (tenor sax, alto sax, flute), Matt Ulery (bass), Michael Caskey (drums). Set list includes Doug's 'Episodes From A Village Dance'. Documents a HotHouse (31 E. Balbo) appearance, which backs the 'Hothouse' entry in site/src/components/Performance.astro. Check the taping/streaming terms before linking or embedding from the site.

entries.title: Chicago Tribune quote used in bio and label copy
pullQuotes: fearlessness of spirit and a robustness of tone that seem likely to win him a devoted following in coming years
entries.notes: Original article NOT found. Appears in Doug's bio (2014 Wayback snapshot) and Boo Boo label copy (2014-05-11). Wording ('in coming years') suggests an earlier article about Doug as a player, not a review of Better Than TV. Do not present it as a CD review until the source is located.

entries.title: Around the Coyote Fall Arts Festival (Doug Rosenberg Quartet)
entries.provenance: Found 2006-09-07 page read 2026-10-23: under FRIDAY 9/8, "Around the Coyote Gallery: Arthi Meera, Emily Hurd, Easy Tiger, and Doug Rosenberg Quartet, 6-9 PM". His own group, not Eastern Blok. The Goran Ivanovic Group is on the same page for Sunday 9/10.
